plan.title: Treatment-specific time-course DE beyond shared trend
plan.analytical_narrative: The design is 2 conditions x 4 time points (t0-t3), 3 replicates per cell (25 samples per the file profile, condition + time + time_hours columns in metadata), raw salmon gene counts (12000 genes x 25 samples). The research question — which genes change over time in a condition-specific way, beyond the trend shared by both conditions — is precisely the DESeq2 full-vs-reduced likelihood-ratio-test (LRT) time-course design (~condition*time vs ~condition+time), which isolates the condition:time interaction. The knowledge-service flags this LRT usage as a violation of the permitted differential_expression method set for this situation profile (which is keyed to a two-group comparison, not an explicit LRT time-course test), so the plan uses the sanctioned DESeq2 Wald+apeglm machinery on the condition-specific time coefficients (the interaction terms of the ~condition*time model) as the primary inferential test, exactly as R-0092 prescribes for interaction designs (report simple effects at the reference condition, simple effects at the other condition, and the interaction contrast side by side), and states this choice explicitly. QC precedes filtering and modeling; genes are filtered minimally (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group size) and independent filtering does the rest at the BH/alpha=0.05 stage. Because R-0091 requires trajectory-level reporting for >=3 timepoints, genes with a significant interaction are clustered by their per-condition log2FC-vs-t0 trajectories and reported by cluster with mean profiles, not as single fold-change numbers. Enrichment: the knowledge check rejected fgsea/Hallmark for this situation profile (a two-group comparison keyed as gene-list-appropriate), so GO over-representation (clusterProfiler enrichGO, tested genes as universe, rrvgo redundancy reduction) is used on the interaction-significant gene list, with the size of that list stated explicitly since the R-0103 warning (an ORA on <50 genes has little power) applies if the hit list is short. Reactome pathway sets are staged locally and used as a second-pass ORA lens on the same gene list for triangulation. All reference gene sets and reports name their organism (human) and version explicitly.
